profile_text.body:
Zhejiang University, abbreviated ZJU, is a non-profit university based in Hangzhou, China, with an English-language site at zju.edu.cn. The site presents it as a research institution, and its profile classifies it as a university lab.

The material published on the site is research news and seminar listings rather than product information. One item describes researchers in China developing a way to produce super-resolution images without external light excitation, using instead the faint light generated by chemical reactions. Another reports that an international research team led by XIANG Rong from the School of Mechanical Engineering at Zhejiang University achieved the first preferred synthesis of transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMDC) nanotubes, addressing control of chirality during synthesis. A third concerns the Madagascar periwinkle, the only known natural source of vinblastine, a chemotherapy drug used to treat leukemia, lymphoma and several other cancers. The site also lists seminars with speakers Xinyue Ye of the University of Alabama, Hans Koster of Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, and Krzysztof Matyjaszewski.

The record holds no AI products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers connected to the university.
